title: Multi-Agent Authoring Product Bar Self-Assessment
description: Honest self-assessment of a multi-agent authoring product against the dogfood product-quality bar: table-stakes parity with incumbent single-agent tools (Claude Code, Codex), real (non-Potemkin) coordination differentiators, and an honest stickiness signal.

product.description: Name/version of the product being assessed, e.g. 'Port Daddy Agent Harbor v0.4'.

tableStakes.description: The single-agent inner loop this product must MATCH the incumbent on before multi-agent claims matter.

singleAgentLoop.description: Prompt-to-plan-to-diff-to-review quality versus the incumbent the makers use daily.

latency.description: Perceived responsiveness of a single agent turn: time-to-first-token, time-to-plan, time-to-diff.

contextAttach.description: How cheaply the right context (selection, terminal output, failed test, PR, screenshot) reaches the agent.

recoverableEdits.description: Whether a single agent's edits can be reviewed, checkpointed, and reverted as cheaply as in the incumbent.

differentiatorThreshold.description: Minimum count of real (non-Potemkin) differentiators required to pass. Defaults to 3 of 5.

differentiators.description: The coordination/visibility/recovery control plane axes incumbents don't expose. Each must be present, have real behavior, and leave a receipt to count as real.

stickiness.description: The honest dogfood signal: does someone reach for this over the incumbent for real work, and why.

comebackTriggers.description: Concrete, sourced comeback moments, drawn from the documented vocabulary, not vague self-praise.

usesOverIncumbentForRealWork.description: True only if a maker has actually chosen this tool over Claude Code/Codex for real, non-demo work.

metricsHonest.description: True only if the team's reported success metrics avoid vanity counts (agents-launched, demos-run) as the primary signal.

present.description: The capability exists in the shipped product, not just the roadmap.

hasRealBehavior.description: It does something real end-to-end, not a button with no backing state machine.

leavesReceipt.description: It produces a durable, inspectable artifact (claim log, transcript, receipt, spend record) after the fact.
